description: Load this skill whenever the project contains charts, graphs, data visualizations, infographics, or any visual representation of data (bar charts, line charts, pie charts, scatter plots, dashboards). Under no circumstances render a chart without a text alternative, data table, or summary. Prioritize conveying the same information through non-visual means.
